declaration.title: Selected Artifact Registry image has no detected secrets
declaration.remediation: Remove literal secrets from image configuration and layers, rebuild the image, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the selected immutable image configuration or a layer.
The value is hidden; credentials were not validated.

selection.trusted_named_check: _content_secret_scan_kinds includes artifact_image from exact named check ID
selection.selected_artifact_images: 1–4 exact bare LOCATION-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/IMAGE@sha256:digest strings, unique, within one explicit selected project

native_authority.image: Existing gcp_sbom_native._images/_digest_uri URI, digest, repository and percent-decoded native DockerImage name binding.
native_authority.repository: Exactly one complete native artifact_repository with matching project/location/repository and format DOCKER.
native_authority.project: Exactly one native CRM v3 project with projectId matching selected project; numeric project authority is name=projects/123456789 plus projectId, never an invented projectNumber field.
native_authority.partial_inventory: Incomplete/duplicate/missing parent inventory or selected image cannot authorize registry reads.

acquisition.method: Authenticated HTTPS GET on fixed selected host and /v2/PROJECT/REPO/IMAGE/manifests/sha256:digest or /blobs/sha256:digest only.
acquisition.authentication: Native credentials.headers Bearer token is used transiently as Google-documented Basic oauth2accesstoken password on the selected registry host only. No auth challenge exchange or external realm request.
acquisition.session: Dedicated requests.Session, trust_env=False, no ambient auth/proxy configuration, cookies cleared before each GET, redirects=False, streaming identity encoding and exact response URL.
acquisition.metadata_pages: Uses existing native inventories and their collector page/call bounds; binary inspection performs no tag listing or pagination.
acquisition.cache: Binary reader is separate from Transport JSON cache. Raw image/config/layer content stays in bounded local memory and never enters request evidence, snapshot or output artifacts.
acquisition.safe_request_provenance: Every successful/failed registry attempt appends a safe request receipt with method/constant operation/scope/category/digest/status/attempt counts/HTTPstatus, never raw URL/body/auth/token/error strings. Each exact per-image receipt slice is linked from row provenance, marker coverage and image envelope, and final snapshot metadata retains the receipts.

integrity.manifest: Actual response bytes match explicitly selected immutable SHA256; OCI manifest or Docker schema2 only.
integrity.descriptors: Strict digest/size/mediaType descriptors with no external URLs; each config/layer stream is length-checked and SHA256 verified before scanning. Freeform descriptor annotations are never retained.
integrity.rootfs: Parsed config rootfs.diff_ids count/order matches layers; SHA256 of each uncompressed layer is checked against its DiffID.
integrity.all_layers: Every supported layer and complete config must succeed before PASS or FAIL; a later error discards any complete verdict.

supported.archive_model: Scan all layer files, including files deleted by later layers; no final merged filesystem is constructed or executed.
supported.config_model: Full verified JSON bytes, including environment/default runtime config/history, are detected offline.

unsupported_unknown: OCI image indexes or manifest lists; no implicit platform selection
Other platforms, zstd/nondistributable/foreign layers or external descriptor URLs
Missing/oversized/corrupt config or layers, malformed JSON, stream/digest/size mismatch, DiffID mismatch
Links/devices/PAX or other archive extensions, unsafe paths, duplicate paths, nested archives, gzip concatenation, truncated TAR
Denied responses, redirects, external or successful auth challenges, unsupported encoding, unavailable tools, cancellation and exhausted bounds

bounds.transport_budget: Each GET also consumes the existing native max_calls budget and checks native cancellation.
bounds.archive_timeout: Deadline facade reserves at least31seconds before reused TAR scanner checks, covering its two fixed at-most15second detection adapters.

reuse.tar: Inspected aws_package_content_indicators.scan_tar reused unchanged with a deadline facade and additional bounded nested-archive preflight. Only regular files/directories; no filesystem extraction.
reuse.dual_tools: Shared scan_content: pinned Kingfisher1.4.0 and TruffleHog3.92.5, detection only, no verification, no updates, no archive traversal within detectors.
reuse.dedup: Shared merge_leaks plus existing engine deduplicate_secret_findings merge exact matched values via process-HMAC fingerprints across tools/config/layers/services.

verdicts.PASS: Complete native binding, verified complete config/all supported layers and both offline tools complete with no supported secret match.
verdicts.FAIL: Same complete coverage with at least one likely-secret match; hidden value and credential validation not attempted.
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Default/unselected, incomplete/unsupported/unbound content or any acquisition/integrity/tool/budget error; never a truncated clean result.

validation.real_collector_proof: Actual GCPCollector class compiled with the exact proposed post-SBOM hook in memory; mock native HTTP collects numeric CRM project, repository, DockerImage and Compute hydration, followed by synthetic streaming registry responses.
validation.privacy: Synthetic secret absent from native Transport cache/evidence, final snapshot, returned marker and shared detector result cache; image bytes never enter JSON cache.
validation.patch_checks: Both root proposal patches pass git apply --check against current root files

privacy_filename_hardening: After original layer digest/DiffID checks, only TAR header names are replaced with member ordinals before the reused scanner; every file payload byte and order are preserved, original paths are checked for traversal/duplicates, and raw filenames never enter detector caches.
